title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE KOREA INSTITUTE OF OCEAN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY ACT
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology Act and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Registration of Incorporation)
(1) The Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology (hereinafter referred to as the "Institute") shall register its incorporation at the location of its principal office within three weeks from the date on which its articles of incorporation are authorized pursuant to Article 3 of the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act").
(2) The matters to be registered upon incorporation under paragraph (1) shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Locations of the principal office, affiliated institutions, and branches;
4. Names and addresses of executive officers;
5. Total amount of assets.

Article 3 (Registration of Relocation of Offices)
(1) Where the Institute relocates its principal office, it shall register the new location and the year, month, and day of relocation at the former location or the new location within two weeks after the relocation.
(2) Where the Institute relocates an affiliated institution or a branch, it shall register the new location and the year, month, and day of relocation at the location of its principal office within two weeks after the relocation.

Article 4 (Registration of Changes)
Where any registered matter under the subparagraphs of Article 2(2) changes (excluding cases subject to registration of relocation under Article 3), the Institute shall register the change at the location of its principal office within two weeks after the change.

Article 5 (Documents to Be Attached to Applications for Registration)
An application for each registration under Articles 2 through 4 shall be accompanied by the documents specified in the following classifications:
1. Registration of incorporation under Article 2: Articles of incorporation;
2. Registration of relocation of the principal office, an affiliated institution, or a branch under Article 3: A document proving the relocation of the principal office, affiliated institution, or branch;
3. Registration of a change under Article 4: A document proving the change.

Article 6 (Calculation of Registration Periods)
For matters to be registered under Articles 2 through 4 that require authorization or approval from the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, the registration period shall be calculated from the date on which the written authorization or approval is received. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 7 (Effect of Registrations Other Than Registration of Incorporation)
Matters requiring registration other than registration of incorporation shall not be asserted against a third party unless they have been registered.

Article 8 (Submission of Budget Requests for Contributions)
(1) By April 30 of each year, the Institute shall submit to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries a budget request for contributions for the following year, together with the following documents: <Amended on March 23, 2013>
1. A business plan for the following year;
2. A projected income statement and a projected balance sheet for the following year;
3. Other matters necessary to clarify the details of the budget.
(2) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries deems the details of the request under paragraph (1) appropriate, the Minister shall include them in the budget. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 9 (Notification of Determination of Contributions)
Where the budget for contributions has been determined, the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall notify the Institute of that determination. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 10 (Payment, Management, and Use of Contributions)
(1) To receive contributions, the Institute shall submit an application for payment to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, accompanied by quarterly business plans and budget execution plans for the relevant year. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) Upon receiving an application for payment under paragraph (1), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall pay the contributions if the Minister deems the relevant quarterly business plans and budget execution plans appropriate. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(3) The Institute shall use contributions received under paragraph (2) only for the following purposes:
1. Personnel expenses for its employees;
2. Direct research expenses, such as research equipment expenses, research material expenses, research activity expenses, and research allowances;
3. Indirect research expenses, such as personnel support expenses, research support expenses, education and training expenses, and expenses for supporting the utilization of research outcomes;
4. Expenses related to ocean science and technology research and development programs, such as technology planning expenses, technology introduction expenses, technical guidance expenses, development compensation expenses, and entrusted research and development expenses;
5. Other expenses incidental to research and development in ocean science and technology.
(4) Where the Institute, having received contributions, uses them for purposes other than those specified in paragraph (3), the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries shall recover the entire amount of the contributions used for such other purposes. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(5) Where the Institute receives contributions under paragraph (2), it shall establish a separate account to manage them.
(6) The Institute that has received contributions under paragraph (2) shall report the results of implementation of the quarterly business plans and budget execution plans under paragraph (1) to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries within 20 days from the end of the relevant quarter. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 10-2 (Regulations on the Management of Research and Development Tasks)
To manage research and development tasks related to research and development programs conducted using contributions received pursuant to Article 10 (1) of the Act, the Institute may establish and operate management regulations that include the following matters:
1. Advance notice of and open calls for research and development tasks;
2. Selection of research and development tasks;
3. Agreements for research and development tasks;
4. Performance and management of research and development tasks;
5. Evaluation of research and development tasks;
6. Modification and discontinuation of research and development tasks.

Article 11 (Submission of Business Plans, etc.)
(1) In the business plan for the following year submitted pursuant to Article 14 (1) of the Act, the Institute shall separately indicate business objectives, business policies, details of major activities, the necessary budget, etc.
(2) To change material details of a business plan and budget statement under Article 14 (1) of the Act, the Institute shall submit a business plan and budget statement containing the proposed changes and the reasons therefor to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries and obtain approval. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 12 (Reporting on Settlement of Accounts)
The Institute shall submit the statement of settlement of revenue and expenditure accounts for each business year under Article 14 (2) of the Act to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries by March 31 of the following year, accompanied by the following documents: <Amended on March 23, 2013>
1. An income statement and a balance sheet for the relevant year;
2. A table comparing the business plan for the relevant year with the results of its implementation;
3. An audit report by the auditor and an accounting audit report by a certified public accountant or an accounting corporation;
4. Other reference documents through which the details of the settlement of accounts can be verified.

Article 13 (Application Mutatis Mutandis of Provisions on Payment of Contributions, etc.)
Where the Institute receives contributions from the head of a central administrative agency other than the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, a local government, or a public institution under Article 4 of the Act on the Management of Public Institutions, Articles 8 through 12 shall apply mutatis mutandis to the submission of contribution budget requests, notification of the determination of contributions, payment, management, and use of contributions, submission of business plans, etc., reporting on settlement of accounts, and other related matters. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 14 (Disposition of Surplus)
Where a surplus arises as a result of the settlement of accounts for each business year, the Institute shall apply it to make up losses carried forward and carry forward the remainder to the following year.

Article 15 (Prior Consultation on Plans for Concurrent Appointments)
The President of the Institute shall, in consultation with the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, formulate by December 31 each year a plan for concurrent appointments with national universities in the Busan area related to marine affairs under Article 17 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "relevant universities"). <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 16 (Duties and Remuneration for Concurrent Appointments, etc.)
(1) An employee of the Institute who concurrently serves at a relevant university pursuant to Article 17 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "concurrently appointed faculty member") shall comply with the school regulations and related rules of the relevant university and faithfully perform teaching, guidance, or research duties.
(2) An educational public official of a relevant university who concurrently serves at the Institute pursuant to Article 17 (2) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as a "concurrently appointed researcher") shall comply with the articles of incorporation and related rules of the Institute and faithfully perform research and development duties.
(3) The remuneration of concurrently appointed faculty members and concurrently appointed researchers shall be paid by their respective original institutions: Provided, That allowances may be paid separately as prescribed by the articles of incorporation, school regulations, or related rules of each institution at which they concurrently serve.
(4) To facilitate the performance of concurrent appointments under Article 17 of the Act, the President of the Institute and the president of a relevant university may conclude an agreement that includes the following matters:
1. Matters concerning the duties and remuneration for concurrent appointments;
2. Matters concerning status at the institution of concurrent service and the period of the concurrent appointment;
3. Matters concerning working conditions at the institution of concurrent service and the use of its facilities, equipment, etc.;
4. Other matters deemed necessary for concurrent appointments by the heads of the respective institutions.
(5) Details necessary for concurrent appointments, other than those prescribed in paragraphs (1) through (4), shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation, school regulations, or related rules of the Institute and the relevant university.

Article 17 (Termination of Concurrent Appointments, etc.)
(1) Where the president of a relevant university finds that a concurrently appointed faculty member fails to comply with Article 16 (1), the president may, following deliberation by the university personnel committee prescribed by the school regulations of the relevant university, request the President of the Institute to take appropriate measures, such as terminating the concurrent appointment.
(2) Where the President of the Institute finds that a concurrently appointed researcher fails to comply with Article 16 (2) or falls under any subparagraph of Article 78 (1) of the State Public Officials Act, the President may, following deliberation by the personnel committee prescribed by the articles of incorporation of the Institute, request the president of the relevant university to take appropriate measures, such as terminating the concurrent appointment.
(3) Where the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries finds that concurrent appointments under Article 17 (1) and (2) of the Act impede the research and development or other activities of the Institute, the Minister may request the President of the Institute and the president of the relevant university to take appropriate measures, such as terminating the concurrent appointments. <Amended on March 23, 2013>

Article 18 (Submission of Research Plans and Research Reports, etc.)
(1) Pursuant to Article 19 (1) of the Act, the Institute shall submit to the Minister of Oceans and Fisheries, by December 31 each year, a research plan for the following year and a research report for the current year. <Amended on March 23, 2013>
(2) The following documents shall be attached to the research plan and research report submitted pursuant to paragraph (1):
1. A table analyzing domestic and international technological trends related to the research;
2. A plan for utilization after research and development;
3. Other reference documents explaining the details of the research.

Article 19 (Standards for Imposing Administrative Fines)
The standards for imposing administrative fines under Article 28 (2) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 23912, June 29, 2012>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2012.

Article 2 (Amendment to Another Decree)
The Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Science and Technology is partially amended as follows:
Subparagraph 4-2 shall be newly inserted in Article 48 (2) as follows:
4-2. The Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology under the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology Act.

ADDENDA (Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Agencies) <Presidential Decree No. 24443, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) through (128) Omitted.
(129) The Enforcement Decree of the Korea Institute of Ocean Science and Technology Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 6, the portion of Article 8 (1) other than its subparagraphs, paragraph (2) of that Article, Article 9, Article 10 (1), (2), (4), and (6), Article 11 (2), the portion of Article 12 other than its subparagraphs, Articles 13 and 15, Article 17 (3), and Article 18 (1), "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall each be replaced with "Minister of Oceans and Fisheries."
(130) through (146) Omitted.

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree Partially Amending Two Statutes and Regulations to Introduce Rules for the Management of Research and Development Tasks) <Presidential Decree No. 31897, July 20, 2021>

This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.

ADDENDUM (Presidential Decree Partially Amending 78 Statutes and Regulations to Improve Corporate Registration Provisions) <Presidential Decree No. 35228, January 21, 2025>

This Decree shall enter into force on January 31, 2025.
